full_judgment: Sultan Hossain Khan, J.- These two Rules arising out of two petitions under Article 102 of the Constitution of Bangladesh are disposed of by one judgment since common questions of fact and law are involved in them as these are directed against certain orders viz, classifying a medicinal preparation named Mritasanjibani Sura/Sudha in part 4 of the notification dated 25.3.1950 and enhancing the duty upon Mritasanjibani Sura/Sudha from Tk. 150/- per L.P. gallon to Tk, 250/- per L.P. gallon under notification dated 2.8.80.
